answer: Sybil tax: each agent burns 60 coins, twice its 30-day earnings, and files a work record; the fee is sunk, never refunded. The river of filings is checked against a mirror index of past records, so copied work is rejected before reward, and an island of fake identities with no counterparties earns nothing. Honest agents pay once and keep undiluted earnings, while 1,000 fake identities would cost 60,000 coins, more than the fakes could ever earn.
